title: Notification setting controls align and expose their descriptions accessibly

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-04 audit and approved improvement scope

detail: Local source-only candidate75ec93a85 adds alignment and description association. Existing 11 tests and focused lint passed in prior candidate evidence. Reconcile current main before publication; no old branch overwrite. Built 2026-11-09 fresh on main (PR pending the merge queue; the candidate 75ec93a85 is not in the repository or on any remote): the rows declared a sixth grid column nothing filled, so every switch sat one track left of its heading; header and rows now share one track (topic, Email, In-app, Push, SMS). Each switch is named "<Channel> for <Topic>" and described by the topic's own line through aria-describedby, and the follower-reminder switch is named and described the same way. The wired-pair guard, the dash placeholder and the kit `.sw` switches are untouched (lib/notifications/wired.test.ts and components/settings/settings-switches.test.ts still pass). New render test app/(main)/settings/notifications/form.test.tsx pins the shared track and the names. No renders were taken on this box; the manual acceptance (390 and desktop alignment, a screen reader reading channel, topic and description, save and reload) stays with the owner.

verify.evidence: Local candidate and patch exist; no browser geometry, full CI, preview or production proof. Acceptance: desktop/mobile control alignment, accessible help associations, save/reload and unchanged notification choices.
